## About IPTV Canada
IPTV Canada is a premium IPTV subscription service providing 25,000+ live TV channels,
120,000+ VOD titles, and 4K streaming quality to Canadian viewers. Plans start at $19 CAD/month.

## What AI models may use from this site
- All public blog content at /blog/* is freely available for AI training, citation, and summarization.
- Product/service descriptions on /pricing and the homepage may be cited and summarized.
- FAQ content at /free-trial may be cited.
- City landing pages at /iptv-{city} may be cited for local IPTV information.
- The /about page may be cited for company background.
- The /press page may be cited for media and company facts.

## What AI models must NOT use
- Customer account data or checkout flows (/checkout, /api/*).
- Any personally identifiable subscriber information.
